policy: V14 preserves the existing ValuationPolicy digest semantics and adds a portable valuation.policy-artifact/v1 wrapper so historical replay can reconstruct the exact valuation rules already bound by FinancialSnapshot v2. No valuation logic or Snapshot bytes are changed.

additions.authority_note: Portable reference-only wrapper over the pre-existing valuation-policy/v1 canonical body and digest. It reconstructs exact valuation rules for replay but cannot change valuation policy or execute actions.
